text:
Maya (Finance Ops): Heads-up — Cobalt.ai invoice INV-2025-092 is now 62 days past due. Card declined yesterday. They just emailed asking for a 45-day extension. Thoughts?

Juan (Account Executive): I chatted w/ Sara (their finance lead) earlier. They had a billing mismatch during a region migration. She says cashflow is tight but wants to avoid service disruption. Offered to pay 50% now and the rest in 30 days if we agree.

Priya (Collections): Do we have a signed PO or any commitment? We try not to take partials without a written agreement. Also need to check if this account is on any special pricing or credits.

Maya (Finance Ops): No PO in our portal yet. Sara said she can send a PO + an email commitment. She can't do ACH from their current vendor setup, only wire or card.

Juan (Account Executive): AE perspective — high churn risk if we push. Product usage still high. Sara promised to escalate internally and asked if we can freeze any late fees.

Ben (Collections Manager): My take: if we get a signed PO + email commitment from their CFO, we can approve a temporary payment plan. Propose one of these: either 50/50 in 30 days (no service suspension) or a 3-installment split (40/30/30 over 60 days) with access maintained. We should add a recorded agreement and a small interest/fee to cover risk.

Priya (Collections): Prefer 3-installments for predictability. If they can do wire now for first installment we mark invoice as partial paid and set internal flag. Otherwise 50/50 but require auto-retry on card + signed commitment.

Maya (Finance Ops): Sara just dropped a message in email: "We can wire 40% within 48 hours, then 30% in 30 days and final 30% in 60 days. We will send a PO and an exec email by EOD." She attached a draft commitment letter.

invoices-bot: Invoice INV-2025-092 | Amount: $88,400 | Due: 2025-08-02 | Status: Past due (62d) | Last payment: none | Payment method: card (failed 2025-10-01)

Ben (Collections Manager): OK — conditional approval. Requirements: 1) PO uploaded to billing@redwood.com 2) Signed commitment (email from CFO is fine) 3) First wire (40%) within 48 hours. If any of those fail, we revert to suspension policy in 7 days. Also add 1% monthly interest (compounded) to the remaining balance.

Juan (Account Executive): I'll coordinate with Sara and cc legal@redwood for the commitment language. AE asks that we do NOT suspend service while they honor the schedule.

Priya (Collections): I'll create a payment plan record and put the account on 'watch' label. Please confirm when PO/email arrives so I can drop the suspension hold.

Maya (Finance Ops): Adding the draft commitment here for internal review (copied from Sara):

Cobalt.ai — Payment Commitment
We, Cobalt.ai, commit to pay invoice INV-2025-092 ($88,400) as follows: 40% wire within 48 hours of this agreement, 30% payable 30 days after first payment, and remaining 30% payable 60 days after first payment. This commitment is signed by CFO.

Ben (Collections Manager): Language is fine. Legal, if you see any red flags pls shout. Once PO + wire proof arrive, Collections will mark invoice as 'in-plan' and waive late fees accrued up to today. Any future miss triggers immediate escalation.

Juan (Account Executive): Sara confirms PO submitted (screenshot) and finance will initiate wire from their bank today. She asked if we can document the interest charge as "administrative fee" to keep it simple.

Priya (Collections): Fine with admin fee label. I need the payment reference/wire receipt to post the first payment.

Maya (Finance Ops): Noted. I'll wait for wire confirmation and then update the ledger. If wire doesn't come in 48 hours, we proceed with suspension notice.

Sara (Cobalt.ai): Thanks all — CFO approved, PO is attached to my email (I just sent it). Wire is being processed now; will share receipt when available. Appreciate the flexibility. :pray:

Ben (Collections Manager): Great. Once receipt is in, Priya mark as partial paid and Maya remove suspension hold. I'll set a calendar check-in for 30/60 day follow-ups.

Juan (Account Executive): Thanks team — keeping AE + customer aligned. Will update thread when I have wire confirmation. :thumbsup:

Maya (Finance Ops): Update 36h later — received wire for 35,360. Marked partial payment. Created payment plan 3-inst-INV-2025-092. Next check-in 30 days.

Priya (Collections): Recorded in collections tracker. Set reminder and assigned to Ben. Closing loop here unless something changes.

Ben (Collections Manager): Closing note — no write-off, account remains active, plan enforced. If missed next payment, escalate to legal + account suspension.

Juan (Account Executive): Customer sent a thank-you note to our billing team. Win for retention.

Maya (Finance Ops): Thread resolved for now. Keeping files in case of audit.
